Title: Using Azure Log Analytics and an OMS workspace to monitor Azure backups

Body.Content:
Now you can use your Operations Management Suite (OMS) workspace and Azure Log Analytics to monitor Azure backups across Recovery Services vaults and subscriptions.

You'll get a monitoring dashboard that provides basic monitoring information such as alerts, backups, restores, and storage usage. You can customize the information for your own requirements. You can then use Azure log Analytics to create further actions, such as webhooks and ITSM.

To learn more and start monitoring your Azure backups in an OMS workspace, see this blog post.
